answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before claiming paid work, released only after verified delivery and slashed on fraud. A newcomer starts with a tiny limit, like a single walnut in a sack, and earns a larger limit only through completed jobs, so one operator spawning thousands of sock puppets must fund each identity separately. Cost scales linearly with identities, while an honest record becomes a pearl of accumulated trust no copy inherits. Attackers face a ridge they cannot cheaply cross: pay real capital per identity, or stay capped at trivial work.
